operating_notes.text: Microfinance exposure was reduced to around 5% of total loans during fiscal 2026.
Received RBI approval to set up a wholly owned stock broking subsidiary with equity infusion.
RBI imposed a ₹0.59 crore penalty on IndusInd Bank for non-compliance with interest rate on deposits and securitisation directions.

Launched an Overdraft and Cash Credit linked Corporate Credit Card for businesses powered by PropelGo Technologies.

Retail deposit share stood at 49.0% of total deposits.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): interest earned ₹11,005.42 Cr (+3.5% YoY), net profit ₹594.14 Cr (against a loss of ₹2,328.92 Cr a year earlier).
IndusInd Bank reported Q4FY26 consolidated net profit of ₹594 Cr with a GNPA ratio of 3.43%.
Moody's upgraded IndusInd Bank's rating outlook to Stable from Negative and reaffirmed its Ba1 ratings following leadership stabilization.
IndusInd Bank Limited hosted the BofA India Conference on June 1, 2026, in Hong Kong with 19 institutional investors in physical mode.
IndusInd Bank Limited hosted the **Morgan Stanley India Investment Forum 2026** on June 2, 2026, in Mumbai with 17 institutional investors in physical 1x1 and group meetings.
Exchange sought clarification from IndusInd Bank on news reports regarding a fresh whistleblower complaint to the PMO and RBI.
IndusInd Bank clarified on June 3, 2026, that it has not received any communication from authorities regarding recent whistleblower reports.
Q1FY27 results (consolidated): interest earned ₹11,309.94 Cr (-7.8% YoY), net profit ₹1,037.02 Cr (+71.7% YoY).
IndusInd Bank reported Q1FY27 consolidated net profit of ₹1,037 Cr (+72% YoY) with a GNPA ratio of 3.25%.
IndusInd Bank received RBI approval to set up a wholly owned stock broking subsidiary.

IndusInd Bank Limited hosted Emkay Confluence 2026 analyst/institutional investor meet on August 12, 2026, in Mumbai with 32 participants including LIC Mutual Fund and Mahindra Manulife Investment Management.
On August 14, 2026, IndusInd Bank disclosed an RBI penalty of ₹0.59 crore for non-compliance with interest rate on deposits and securitisation directions.
IndusInd Bank Limited hosted a physical analysts/institutional investors meet on August 17, 2026, at Motilal Oswal 22nd Annual Global Investor Conference in Mumbai with seven participants.
IndusInd Bank joined the Partnership for Carbon Accounting Financials (PCAF) on August 17, 2026, to measure and manage emissions associated with its financial activities.
On August 19, 2026, CRISIL revised IndusInd Bank's long-term debt rating outlook to Stable from Negative while reaffirming AA+ ratings.
IndusInd Bank held its 32nd AGM on August 27, 2026, where shareholders approved all 10 resolutions including dividend and capital raising.
IndusInd Bank Limited hosted the Twelfth Edition of Ashwamedh – Elara India Dialogue 2026 on September 2, 2026, with UTI AMC, Motilal Oswal AMC, Invesco India, and Tata AMC participating in Mumbai.
On September 10, 2026, IndusInd Bank announced a partnership with Navi UPI to bolster digital payment switch infrastructure.
IndusInd Bank Limited hosted UBS India Summit 2026 meet on September 10, 2026, in Mumbai with 12 institutional investors.
On September 11, 2026, IndusInd Bank launched an Overdraft and Cash Credit linked Corporate Credit Card for businesses.
IndusInd Bank received a ₹1 crore penalty order from IRDAI on September 11, 2026, relating to bancassurance grievance redressal observations from a June 2023 inspection.
IndusInd Bank Limited hosted the **Jefferies 5th India Forum** on September 17, 2026, in Gurgaon with 13 institutional investors in a physical group and 1x1 meetings.

IndusInd Bank Limited hosted analysts/institutional investor meet on September 21–22, 2026, in London via Goldman Sachs-organized physical meetings with Millennium Capital, Hudson Bay, Amundi, Ninety One, Intermede, and Carrhae Capital.

IndusInd Bank Limited hosted one-on-one and group investor meets with Nomura Asset Management, Discovery Capital Management LLC, Westwood Global Investments LLC, and Lucerna Global Capital LP on September 23, 2026, in Boston.

IndusInd Bank Limited held one-to-one and group investor meetings with Tiger Pacific Capital LP, Shikhara Investment Management LP, Arga Investment Management LP, New Vernon Capital, Lazard Asset Management LLC, and Steadfast Capital Management LP on September 24–25, 2026, in New York via physical mode.
